calls.prompt: Edit the supplied exact canonical athlete/barbell scene into the START master for BARBELL SHRUG. Keep athlete identity, head/torso/limb proportions, body position, feet, white low-top shoes, bar position at thighs, bar length and ONE modest plate each side, camera crop/zoom and black background identical. Change ONLY grip and muscle highlights for the exercise: both hands must use a closed OVERHAND pronated shoulder-width grip, knuckles forward and thumbs wrapped, rather than the supplied underhand curl grip. Arms hang straight with elbows unbent. Shoulders relaxed at neutral, not elevated yet. Remove purple entirely from biceps and chest. Highlight only the visible UPPER TRAPEZIUS fibres running from back of neck to shoulder tops in deep purple; don't colour front neck/SCM or entire deltoids. Forearm gripping muscles light lilac, subtle pale trunk. Keep anatomy contours sharp and muscles the same size. Six-frame plan is neutral / small shrug / middle shrug / top / middle lowering / nearly neutral; show only neutral here. One separate native1024x1536 image, no text, labels or UI.

Edit this exact BARBELL SHRUG master into frame2 BEGIN SHRUG. Raise the shoulder girdle and BOTH straight hanging arms by a small vertical amount, about15pixels. The rigid bar rises by the same15pixels, with both ends level. Keep elbows unbent, wrists straight, overhand grip width unchanged. Head, jaw, neck centre, torso/ribcage, hips, knees and shoes must stay exactly fixed. Only shoulder elevation/scapular motion, not a curl or upright row; no leaning, rolling or arm shortening. Same bar length/thickness, same one plate each side, same perspective and plate dimensions. Upper trapezius purple unchanged, forearms lilac unchanged, all other anatomy white. Same black canvas and camera, no text. One separate native1024x1536 image.

Edit this exact BARBELL SHRUG middle position into the TOP. Elevate both shoulders only a SMALL additional amount, around15–20pixels, keeping the head perfectly stationary and neck neutral. The straight arms carry the rigid bar upward by the SAME amount. Do not bend elbows, pull with biceps, tilt bar, lean torso or lift heels. Shoulders approach ears but do not touch them or deform neck. All head, ribcage, hips, legs and shoe positions and dimensions remain fixed. Same overhand closed grip, identical bar and one plate per side with no size/perspective changes. Upper traps remain deep purple, forearms lilac, no new highlights. One native1024x1536 standalone frame on black, no text.

Leave the chest/abdominal centre at its original coordinates. This is small shoulder elevation with a neutral neck, elbows straight, identical closed overhand grip and plate sizes. Preserve every other detail and exact image registration. Black background, white anatomical athlete, purple upper trapezius. One separate native1024x1536 image, no text.

conversion: Lossless WebP decoded RGB exactly equals reviewed PNG. No scaling.
measurementMethod: Interpolated minimum-RGB150 scanline boundaries on native selected PNGs. Unrounded1px/1percent tests measure fixed contacts only, not moving anatomy or equipment.
